expected_level_description: You can: - lead organisation-wide restructures and service transfers - design the organisation's approach to change, including partnership working - advise the board on the people impact and risk of major change

You can: - lead workforce planning for a directorate, linking it to service and financial plans - identify skills gaps and recommend ways to close them - plan new roles, career pathways, and skill mix

You can: - lead the organisation's approach to employee relations and partnership working - handle the most sensitive or high-risk cases, including employment claims - negotiate collective agreements and resolve collective disputes

You can: - interpret employment law and policy for complex cases and advise on risk - draft and review people policies, with equality impact assessments - consult on policy changes with staff representatives

You can: - diagnose organisational issues and design interventions to address them - lead team development, leadership development, and engagement programmes - evaluate the effect of interventions using evidence

You can: - run skills gap analysis for a team or profession and report the results - design career pathways and development routes using framework levels - use framework skills to write consistent job descriptions and assessments

You can: - write and lead people plans for a directorate in line with the people strategy - advise senior leaders on people risks and priorities - lead part of the HR function, setting its standards and priorities

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload
